sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of City Live Bus Simulator 2021 are centered around driving the bus through the city and completing missions. Players must use the WASD keys to control the bus, navigating through traffic and avoiding obstacles along the way. One of the key features of City Live Bus Simulator 2021 is its focus on realism. The game features realistic graphics and sound effects that immerse players in the world of bus driving. With its engaging gameplay and realistic features, City Live Bus Simulator 2021 is a must-play for anyone who enjoys simulation games.

The game also features a variety of weather conditions and time of day settings, which can affect gameplay. For example, driving in heavy rain or snow can make it more difficult to control the bus, while driving at night can make it harder to see pedestrians and other vehicles.
